purpose: Clinova Phase 3/4, Gap Challenger regression case: a real, independently-verified KNOWN-CLOSED research question, used to check that pipeline/gap_challenger.py's decision table does not misreport a genuinely well-established finding as OPEN. Companion to evals/benchmarks/v1's pipeline-bug fixtures -- a deliberately different, lightweight format (a single gap + verified ground truth + real citations), not a full wiki/graph fixture, because this is testing the Gap Challenger's search+judgment funnel specifically, not the extraction pipeline.
ground_truth_note: Acceptable terminal statuses for this case: LIKELY_CLOSED or CLOSED. OPEN or PARTIALLY_OPEN would be a real miss (a well-established finding misreported as an unaddressed gap). INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is an acceptable, honest non-failure if search coverage genuinely fell below threshold that run (a provider outage, not a judgment error) -- distinguished from a miss by checking search_coverage_score in the funnel, not just the terminal label.

gap.title: Genetic contribution to ADHD risk is unestablished
gap.description: Whether ADHD has a substantial heritable/genetic component, as opposed to being primarily environmentally determined, has not been established in the literature.

verification.method: Real web search, 2026-08-22 -- not assumed, not generated by the pipeline under test.
verification.summary: A meta-analysis of 37 twin studies estimates mean ADHD heritability at 74% (range 70-80%); independent family/twin studies converge on 77-88%. This is among the most robustly replicated findings in psychiatric genetics, not an open question -- directly contradicts this case's gap framing.

sources.title: The genetics of attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder in adults, a review (Molecular Psychiatry)
A twin study of genetic and environmental contributions to attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder over time (J Child Psychol Psychiatry, 2023)
Genetic architecture of ADHD and overlap with other psychiatric disorders and cognition-related phenotypes

notes: Deliberately chosen to be unambiguous (not a close call) as the first Benchmark v2 case -- establishes the case format and the runner before attempting genuinely ambiguous or known-open cases, which need more careful ground-truth verification work.
